textRuns.value: Hospital access limits: Straight-line distance from the 1 km cell centre, not road distance or travel time. OpenStreetMap hospitals are volunteer-mapped and thinner in rural areas, so remote distances are upper bounds; clinics and primary health centres tagged otherwise are not counted. Public and private hospitals of any size count the same; capacity is unknown. WorldPop 2025 is a modelled 1 km population estimate.
